verdict.rationale: React's docs and GitHub emphasize composable, encapsulated components and incremental adoption ('as little or as much as you need'), which supports maintainability, and streaming SSR/server components support performance at scale (react-docs-4/6/7, react-gh-1/3/4). However, community commentary raises real concerns about internal complexity (fiber/concurrent mode) and bundle size that could affect large-team maintainability, and there is no first-party evidence of large-scale case studies, type-safety tooling, or benchmarks proving performance at scale. Missing for 10: concrete large-app performance benchmarks, enterprise/team-scaling case studies, and tooling for maintainability (e.g., testing, static typing integration) evidence.
